_comment: Copy this file to forge.config.json, edit every value, then run ./setup.sh. Each path is independent — they do NOT have to live under a common root. Use absolute paths or ~ (expanded at setup time). skill_prefix renames the whole skill family (forge-* -> <prefix>-*) and is baked at install; changing it later requires re-running setup.sh. All *_dir / *_path values are read at RUNTIME, so you can edit them in the installed config (~/.config/forge-kit/<prefix>.json) without re-running setup.
